papers.title: Conformal Robustness in Prediction-Driven Decision-Making
papers.abstract: Modern prediction-driven decision systems often rely on black-box predictors, but a point forecast alone does not provide the uncertainty scale required for robust downstream decision-making. We build a score-calibrated robustness framework that converts any fixed point predictor into a decision-relevant uncertainty representation through distribution-free conformal calibration. We use the conformal score, rather than a particular uncertainty set, as the primitive unit of robustness. The same score determines coverage-calibrated uncertainty sets for reliability-based robust optimization and normalizes target violations in a target-oriented formulation, Conformal Robust Satisficing. This formulation induces a conformal fragility measure that quantifies how rapidly performance deteriorates as the realized parameter departs from the forecast on the conformal score scale. For objective-uncertainty problems under standard convexity and duality conditions, we show that the reliability-based and target-oriented formulations parameterize the same score-calibrated robust decision frontier. This equivalence yields a data-driven mapping between reliability levels and acceptable targets and characterizes the marginal cost of robustness. Synthetic experiments validate the theoretical guarantees and illustrate the reliability-target correspondence. A real-data online-grocery case study demonstrates how the interface combines deep-learning demand forecasts with tractable inventory optimization, thereby improving reliability and reducing operational costs. Overall, our work shows that conformal scores endow fixed black-box predictors with an interpretable uncertainty scale for downstream decision-making while enabling reliability guarantees, acceptable-target selection, and fragility analysis within a unified framework.
papers.summary: 黑箱预测器通常只给点预测，稳健决策却需要可校准的不确定性尺度。该文把分布无关的 conformal score 作为统一的稳健性单位：一方面用其构造带有限样本覆盖保证的不确定集，另一方面在 Conformal Robust Satisficing 中用其归一化目标违约，并以 fragility 描述性能随预测偏离而恶化的速度。对目标函数不确定、满足凸性与强对偶条件的问题，作者证明可靠性驱动的稳健优化与目标驱动的 satisficing 参数化同一条决策前沿，从而给出可靠性水平、可接受目标和稳健性边际代价之间的数据驱动映射。理论同时提供覆盖和决策效率证书，并由合成实验及在线杂货库存案例验证。
papers.reason: 最值得阅读的是它没有把某一种不确定集当作固定接口，而是用 conformal score 统一连接预测误差、稳健可行性、目标选择与敏感性分析。两个看似不同的稳健决策范式在标准凸对偶条件下被证明是同一前沿的不同参数化，这为“可靠性要多高”与“目标可放宽多少”的联合选择提供了可解释机制；有限样本证书又不要求预测模型或误差分布具有特定形式。

papers.title: RESIST: Resilient Decentralized Learning Using Consensus Gradient Descent
papers.abstract: Empirical risk minimization (ERM) is a cornerstone of modern machine learning. This paper focuses on the man-in-the-middle (MITM) attack, wherein adversaries exploit communication vulnerabilities between devices to inject malicious updates during training. To address this challenge, we propose RESIST (Resilient dEcentralized learning using conSensus gradIent deScenT), an optimization algorithm designed to be robust against adversarially compromised communication links. RESIST uses a multistep consensus gradient descent framework with robust-statistics-based screening of neighbor messages. It has a design parameter $J$ that controls the frequency of local gradient computation: each local gradient update is preceded by $J-1$ communication and robust aggregation rounds. Compared with methods that perform both communication and a local gradient update at every iteration, RESIST with $J>2$ uses fewer local gradient updates at the same communication budget. We establish geometric algorithmic convergence guarantees for strongly convex and Polyak-Lojasiewicz ERM problems, and sublinear and finite-horizon guarantees for smooth nonconvex ERM problems. For heterogeneous local objectives, these guarantees quantify neighborhoods for the relevant iterate, objective-value, and stationarity errors. In the strongly convex homogeneous case, convergence becomes exact. We also establish statistical learning-rate guarantees under common-population independent and identically distributed sampling assumptions, including regimes in which the statistical error vanishes as the sample size grows. Experimental results demonstrate the robustness of RESIST across diverse attack strategies, screening methods, and loss functions. The $J$-ablation experiments further show that larger $J$ can improve convergence and reduce the number of local gradient updates at a fixed communication budget.
papers.summary: 论文研究通信链路可被时变中间人攻击的去中心化 ERM。RESIST 在每次局部梯度更新前执行 $J-1$ 轮通信与坐标鲁棒筛选，把时间变化的过滤图乘积同梯度递推结合起来，使固定通信预算下可以减少梯度计算。作者对强凸与 PŁ 目标给出收敛到显式邻域的几何保证，对一般光滑非凸目标给出递减步长下的次线性及常步长有限时域保证；局部目标同质的强凸情形可精确收敛，异质情形的误差则由共识和梯度差异项控制。论文还建立了多类目标的统计学习率，实验覆盖不同攻击、筛选方法和损失函数。主要理论依赖图鲁棒性与迭代有界性等假设，后者并未对任意攻击序列自动成立。
papers.reason: 推荐重点是它同时处理时变链路攻击、目标异质性和非凸优化，并把鲁棒通信轮数 $J$ 明确暴露为“多通信、少梯度”的设计旋钮。分析不只证明共识，还分别刻画迭代、函数值与平稳性误差邻域，并把确定性收敛进一步连接到有限样本统计误差；这对研究受攻击时变网络上的分布式优化很直接。阅读时应特别关注迭代有界性假设与投影化修正之间仍待闭合的理论缺口。

papers.title: Distributed Linear Solvers and Data Heterogeneity
papers.abstract: We consider the problem of solving a large-scale system of linear equations in a distributed /federated setting. The taskmaster solves the system with the help of a set of machines, each of which possesses a subset of the equations. While various solutions for this problem exist, a fundamental understanding and rigorous comparison between the convergence rates of the main algorithmic classes - the projection-based methods and the optimization -based ones - is missing. We provide the first comprehensive analysis and comparison of these two classes of algorithms, with a particular focus on the fastest representative method from each class, i.e., the Accelerated Projection-Based Consensus (APC) and the Distributed Heavy-Ball Method. We introduce a novel notion of data heterogeneity called angular heterogeneity, discussing its significance. Using this notion, we characterize and compare the optimal convergence rates of the algorithms of interest and capture the effects of the number of machines, the number of equations, and cross-machine and local data heterogeneity on these rates. Our analysis sheds light on the previously observed superior performance of APC in realistic scenarios, where there is often large data heterogeneity, and provides several insights into the effect of angular heterogeneity on the efficiencies of different algorithms. Additionally, we provide distributed algorithms for efficiently computing the angular heterogeneity metrics. Lastly, as a by-product of this investigation, we obtain a tight bound on the condition number of an arbitrary matrix with full column rank in terms of the Euclidean norms of its columns and the angles between them. Numerical analyses validate our theoretical results, supporting the predicted advantage of APC in the high-heterogeneity regime and providing a deeper understanding of the effects of angular heterogeneity on convergence rates.
papers.summary: 针对各机器持有不同行方程的分布式线性系统，论文比较投影型 APC 与优化型分布式 Heavy-Ball，而不是只用单一条件数解释性能。作者提出跨机器与机器内的 angular heterogeneity，以子空间主角度和局部行向量几何同时描述数据划分；据此推导两类方法的最优收敛率界，显式揭示机器数、方程数和两种异质性如何改变优势区间，并证明高跨机器异质性下 APC 可严格快于 D-HBM。文中还给出分布式计算这些指标的方法，并附带得到一个由列范数与列间角度刻画满列秩矩阵条件数的紧界，数值实验验证了高异质区间的预测。
papers.reason: 这篇论文把“数据异质性为何会改变算法排序”从经验现象变成可计算的几何量和收敛率比较。angular heterogeneity 同时区分跨机器互补性与机器内病态性，能解释传统全局条件数看不见的 APC 优势；对分布式优化而言，它提供了根据数据分区选择投影共识或 Heavy-Ball 的理论依据，也为分析动量方法在异质网络中的边界建立了清楚基线。

papers.title: On a Non-Prox-Regularity Example by Rockafellar and Wets
papers.abstract: We analyze a counterexample concerning non-prox-regular functions provided by Rockafellar and Wets in their 1998 foundational monograph, \textit{Variational Analysis}. By establishing a general theorem on the continuity of set-valued mappings, we show that the counterexample does not have its intended properties. We propose a slight adjustment to the construction and prove that the corrected version serves as the desired counterexample.
papers.summary: Rockafellar–Wets 的经典例子原本意在说明：近端映射即使在原点附近局部常值，也未必推出函数 prox-regular。该文先证明一个关于集值映射连续性的通用定理，再由此指出原构造的近端映射在任意靠近原点处都会出现不连续和多值，因而不具备声称的局部常值性质。作者随后把振荡构造调整为 $|x|(m+\sin(1/(nx)))$（$m>1$），证明修正版在原点邻域的近端映射确实恒定，同时函数仍非 prox-regular，从而恢复目标反例。
papers.reason: 推荐价值在于它修正了一部基础专著中沿用多年的变分分析反例，并把“哪里失效”与“怎样修复”都证明清楚。新集值连续性定理并非只服务于该例子；它把点态收敛、内半连续与交集映射的行为连接起来，可用于审查其他依赖近端映射局部稳定性的论证。篇幅不长，但直接改变了对一个标准例子的正确理解。

papers.title: On Control of Drawdown: Robust Invariance and Optimality
papers.abstract: Mitigating \emph{drawdown}, the decline in wealth from its running peak, presents a canonical problem in path-dependent risk control. In this paper, we develop a finite-horizon control framework that enforces a prescribed maximum percentage drawdown limit in multi-asset stochastic systems. Our first result is an exact robust-invariance theorem characterizing every control action that preserves a prescribed drawdown limit against all supported returns. We show that every robustly safe control admits a \emph{drawdown-modulated} form: the product of the current drawdown \emph{cushion} and a feasible \emph{normalized direction}. This yields a complete parameterization of robustly drawdown-safe policies. Additionally, under stagewise-independent returns, we show that optimizing over all robustly safe causal policies reduces to a one-dimensional Bellman recursion and yields an optimal robustly safe state-feedback policy. Finally, we characterize the linear time-invariant (LTI) gains satisfying a prescribed drawdown limit and prove that optimal drawdown modulation achieves no lower expected return under the same limit. Strict expected-return improvement holds for horizons of at least two stages whenever the LTI policy has positive expected one-stage net return.
papers.summary: 论文研究多资产离散时间系统中必须对全部支持集回报路径成立的最大百分比回撤约束。作者把回撤限制写成增广财富状态的鲁棒不变性，给出安全动作的必要充分支撑函数条件，并证明所有安全控制都可精确分解为“当前回撤 cushion × 归一化安全方向”。在各阶段回报独立、支持集紧且满足正性等条件下，这一齐次分解把对全部安全因果策略的有限时域期望终值优化降为一维 Bellman 递推，并保证存在可测的最优状态反馈。相同回撤上限下，最优调制策略的期望回报不低于任何可行 LTI 策略；当时域至少两步且 LTI 单步净回报满足显式正性条件时严格更高。
papers.reason: 最值得关注的是从完整安全动作刻画到一维动态规划的连续链条：路径依赖的鲁棒约束并未被近似，而是借助 cushion 齐次性得到全部安全策略的精确参数化。它既给出分布无关的逐路径安全保证，又在阶段独立时恢复可计算的全局最优策略，并严格说明相对固定比例 LTI 基准何时存在收益改进；这是结构化鲁棒控制转化为低维优化的一个干净范例。

papers.title: Frictionless Hamiltonian Descent and Coordinate Hamiltonian Descent for Strongly Convex Quadratic Problems
papers.abstract: We propose an optimization algorithm called Frictionless Hamiltonian Descent, which is a direct counterpart of classical Hamiltonian Monte Carlo in sampling. We analyze Frictionless Hamiltonian Descent for strongly convex quadratic functions and show that the method has a non-trivial accelerated rate comparable to that of Heavy Ball flow. We also propose Frictionless Coordinate Hamiltonian Descent and its parallelizable variant, which together encompass the classical Gauss-Seidel method, Successive Over-relaxation, Jacobi method, and more, for solving a linear system of equations. The result not only offers a new perspective on these existing algorithms but also leads to a broader class of update schemes that guarantee convergence.
papers.summary: 该文考察没有摩擦项的 Hamiltonian 流：每段精确演化后只把速度重置为零，并通过选择演化时间优化位置收缩。对强凸二次函数，作者以 Chebyshev 节点安排各段时间，证明距离收缩达到与 Heavy-Ball 流同阶的加速条件数依赖，说明加速并不必然来自耗散摩擦。坐标版本每次只演化一个坐标，涵盖 Gauss–Seidel 与 SOR；并行版本则统一 Jacobi、加权 Jacobi 及更广的收敛更新族。理论目前依赖二次结构与可获得的精确 Hamiltonian 流，实际实现还需处理矩阵函数或数值积分误差。
papers.reason: 这项工作提供了一个有辨识度的加速机制解释：通过保守动力学的相位选择和速度重置，也能产生接近重球流的收缩，而不需要显式摩擦。坐标与并行推导又把多个经典线性求解器放入同一 Hamiltonian 视角，既解释已有方法，也系统产生新的可收敛更新时间表。它的价值主要在结构与统一视角，尚不是面向一般非二次问题的即插即用算法。

papers.title: Fast and Robust Temporal Logic Planning via ADMM-based Trajectory Optimization
papers.abstract: We present a fast numerical method for safe continuous-time motion planning under Temporal Logic (TL) specifications. The method generates smooth continuous trajectories that remain collision-free while robustly satisfying temporal and logical task requirements. A central component of our method is the formulation of nonconvex safety and logic constraints as unions of convex sets where associated discrete decisions are encoded in a joint feasibility graph. This graph representation allows Euclidean projection onto the feasible set and proximal robustness maximization to be reformulated as shortest- and widest-path problems, respectively. Building on this structure, we develop a nonconvex splitting method based on the Alternating Direction Method of Multipliers (ADMM), which decouples smooth spatio-temporal trajectory optimization from nonsmooth discrete constraint handling within the optimization . The resulting algorithm exhibits reliable convergence across benchmarks and scales to large-scale motion-planning problems, providing a 4.7x average speedup over the state of the art on discrete and continuous-time logic problems.
papers.summary: 安全连续时间轨迹规划同时包含平滑动力学、避障以及时序逻辑的离散选择，直接求混合整数或图凸集模型往往规模很大。该文把非凸安全与逻辑约束写成凸集之并，并在联合可行图中编码空间路径和逻辑状态；欧氏投影因此化为最短路，空间或时间鲁棒性的近端最大化化为最宽路。基于这一结构，作者用非凸 ADMM 分离平滑时空轨迹子问题与离散非光滑约束处理。基准上平均比现有方法快 4.7 倍；含 2800 万展开状态的洞穴救援实例在 257 秒内求解，而对照 SOCP 超出内存。结果是可靠的经验收敛，并非非凸 ADMM 的全局收敛保证。
papers.reason: 推荐关注联合可行图如何把安全证书、逻辑满足和鲁棒裕度都变成可并行的图算法原语，再由 ADMM 与连续轨迹优化衔接。它不是简单把已有求解器应用于机器人，而是针对安全关键规划的组合—连续结构重写投影和近端步骤，因而在大规模逻辑状态上获得明确计算优势；边界在于全局最优性与一般非凸收敛仍由经验支撑。

papers.title: Barrier Certificate Synthesis for Non-Polynomial Robotic Dynamics via Polynomial Lifting
papers.abstract: Safe operation of robotic systems requires trajectories to remain within a prescribed safe set under admissible control inputs. Barrier certificates provide such guarantees by certifying a controlled-invariant region within that set. Sum-of-squares optimization offers a systematic way to synthesize such certificates, but its direct application requires polynomial dynamics, excluding common robotic nonlinearities, including trigonometric terms. We address this limitation using exact polynomial lifting, which replaces non-polynomial dynamics with polynomial-augmented dynamics subject to lifting-induced algebraic constraints, preserving nonlinear geometry without approximation. We formulate lifted-domain joint barrier synthesis that computes a certificate with a state-feedback control witness and develop a sampled-data safety filter for zero-order-hold implementation. To assess whether the benefits of lifting persist across synthesis frameworks, we also adapt a sample-guided successive-barrier method to the lifted representation. On coordinated-turn and planar multirotor models, exact lifting improves certified coverage in both methods: at matched sample sizes, lifted successive-barrier synthesis achieves higher coverage with fewer barriers and lower computational cost, while lifted joint barrier synthesis provides higher coverage and lower computational cost than the finest tested piecewise resolution. In closed-loop experiments, the safety filter maintains feasibility and safety across all evaluated trajectories, reduces spatial conservativeness, and requires less intervention for both models.
papers.summary: SOS 障碍证书通常要求多项式动力学，而机器人模型中的三角函数使直接综合失效。该文用带代数等式约束的精确多项式提升替代非多项式状态，在不做分段近似的情况下保留原动力学几何；随后同时给出联合 SOS 综合和适配提升空间的采样引导 successive-barrier 方法，并为零阶保持实现加入固定采样周期的跨采样安全裕度。协调转弯与平面多旋翼实验中，提升模型以更少证书或更低计算成本获得更大认证覆盖，并在全部测试轨迹上保持安全过滤器可行。需要注意，跨采样安全结论以在线 QP 持续可行为条件，并未证明整个认证集合上的递归可行性。
papers.reason: 核心贡献是把常见非多项式机器人动力学精确搬入可做 SOS 综合的代数域，避免细网格分段逼近带来的保守性和规模增长。作者还用两类不同证书综合框架验证收益，并把连续时间证书落实到采样数据安全过滤器；这对安全关键优化中的“模型表达—证书综合—数字实现”链条都有直接价值，同时明确保留了在线可行性这一实际边界。
